summary: Backend-only regression for the new Web Push (VAPID) stack, push/test aggregation, announcement gating, mechanical alerts, 1h reminder helper, and /sw.js delivery. 10/10 pytest cases passed against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2640 lines — consider splitting push/webpush/chat routers into separate modules for maintainability (recurring feedback).
push/test payload sends the same title/body for native and web; consider centralizing so future copy changes stay in sync (minor).
FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
